description: This file defines a CKEditor 5 plugin class 'MediaImageTextAlternativeUi' that provides UI components for editing media image text alternatives, including a button and a form displayed in a balloon overlay.

classes.name: MediaImageTextAlternativeUi
classes.description: A CKEditor 5 plugin class that manages UI for editing media image text alternatives, including a button and a balloon form.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by creating the button and form.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the plugin and its form.

methods.name: _createButton
methods.description: Creates a UI button for toggling the text alternative form.

methods.name: _createForm
methods.description: Creates and manages the balloon form for editing alt text, including event handlers for submit, cancel, and UI updates.

methods.name: _showForm
methods.description: Displays the form in a balloon overlay, populating it with current alt text and metadata.

methods.name: _hideForm
methods.description: Removes the form from the balloon, optionally refocusing the editor.

methods.name: _isVisible
methods.description: Getter that returns true if the form is currently visible in the balloon.

methods.name: _isInBalloon
methods.description: Getter that returns true if the form is currently in the balloon overlay.
